title: [CQ-V04c] Honest frozen gate outcome
description:
Objective: the wrappers' frozen-candidate quality gate never leaves a passing check run behind when the gate mutated its checkout. This is the host half of CQ-V04 DoD 2: "exit 0 followed by a tree/index/HEAD mutation is not a passing trusted result".

Split from CQ-V04 (task-a9d1a74d845b4d3d83f359bf864f8651) on 2026-10-29, at the human's choice in the architect REPL.

The defect today:
- scripts/moe-agent.sh run_frozen_gate (about lines 4602-4636) calls record_check_run_rpc BEFORE gate_integrity, and sends no outcome. The ps1 twin does the same.
- A gate that exits 0 but changes its checkout's tracked tree, index or HEAD is correctly refused for landing, but it still leaves an exit-0 'runner-observed' CheckRun.
- delivery/policy.ts passedOn counts that run under every strict deliveryPolicy, by the legacy no-outcome rule.

Contract (scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1, in string parity):
- After the gate exits, run gate_integrity (sh) or its ps1 twin BEFORE recording.
- Send `outcome` in the CQ-V02 vocabulary:
  - 'passed' only for exit 0 with integrity intact;
  - 'inconclusive' for exit 0 followed by any tracked tree, index or HEAD mutation;
  - 'code-failure' for a nonzero exit.
- Everything else is unchanged: the run's id, candidate, tree, command and tail; the landing refusal and rescue on failure; the [WARN] lines; and legacy deliveryPolicy behaviour.
- moe-agent.ps1 stays UTF-8 with a BOM. Run bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh.
- Depends on every in-flight task that edits these files: CQ-V08 task-2720c13b (after CQ-V07), task-bdf6db6f, task-ad0dc2e7, task-c2a900aa and task-bc8410af. Build on their landed bytes and never revert peers.

Tests: modes in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and scripts/tests/postflight.ps1.
- A gate that edits a tracked file, stages a change, or moves HEAD, then exits 0, records 'inconclusive' and lands nothing.
- A clean exit-0 gate records 'passed'.
- An exit-1 gate records 'code-failure'.

Out of scope: the isolated check VM path (CQ-V04b), daemon policy (CQ-V04), and verified-local.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh
definitionOfDone: A qualityGate that exits 0 after mutating its checkout's tracked tree, index or HEAD records outcome 'inconclusive' and lands nothing, as today. Under a strict deliveryPolicy that run never satisfies required-check.
A clean exit-0 gate records outcome 'passed', a nonzero exit records 'code-failure', and the run is recorded only after the integrity check.
moe-agent.sh and moe-agent.ps1 behave identically (postflight.sh and postflight.ps1 modes), and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh passes.
Fresh verification `bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
